## Central Park Birthday Picnic Plan: July 20th Celebration

Plan a delightful outdoor birthday picnic for 15 guests in Central Park, New York City, on July 20, 2024. This plan focuses on easy-to-prepare, budget-friendly food and essential items to ensure a smooth and enjoyable celebration.

### Food & Drink Suggestions ($200 Budget)
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
Keeping the $200 budget for 15 people in mind, focus on homemade or cost-effective bulk items that are easy to transport and serve.

**Main Dishes & Sides:**
-   **Assorted Sandwiches/Wraps:** Prepare a variety of turkey & cheese, ham & swiss, and vegetarian (cucumber, cream cheese, lettuce) sandwiches or wraps on whole wheat bread/tortillas. Cut into halves for easy serving.
-   **Pasta Salad:** A large batch of cold pasta salad with cherry tomatoes, cucumber, bell peppers, olives, and a light vinaigrette dressing.
-   **Quinoa Salad:** A hearty quinoa salad with chickpeas, corn, black beans, and a lime-cilantro dressing.
-   **Veggie Sticks & Dip:** Carrot sticks, celery sticks, and bell pepper strips with a large tub of hummus or ranch dip.

**Snacks & Dessert:**
-   **Fruit Platter:** A mix of pre-cut watermelon, cantaloupe, grapes, and berries.
-   **Chips/Pretzels:** Large bags of assorted chips and pretzels.
-   **Homemade Brownies/Cookies:** Bake a batch of brownies or cookies, or purchase an economical tray from a local bakery or grocery store.

**Drinks (Non-Alcoholic):**
-   **Water Bottles:** Essential for everyone; purchase in bulk.
-   **Large Jugs of Lemonade/Iced Tea:** Prepare homemade or buy large store-brand jugs.
-   **Juice Boxes/Pouches:** A few options for variety, especially if there are younger guests.

### Essential Picnic Checklist
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/list-check.svg
Ensure you have these items packed for comfort, serving, and cleanup.

**Comfort & Seating:**
-   Large picnic blankets or sheets
-   Portable folding chairs or cushions (optional)
-   Sunscreen and hats
-   Bug spray
-   Small portable speaker

**Food & Drink Management:**
-   Cooler(s) with plenty of ice packs (for food and drinks)
-   Reusable or disposable plates, cups, and cutlery
-   Napkins and paper towels
-   Serving utensils (tongs, spoons)
-   Bottle opener/corkscrew (if bringing sparkling cider or similar)
-   Cutting board and small knife (for last-minute slicing if needed)

**Cleanup & Safety:**
-   Trash bags (several, for all waste)
-   Hand sanitizer
-   Wet wipes
-   First-aid kit (band-aids, antiseptic wipes)

**Activities & Extras:**
-   Birthday candles and lighter
-   Small birthday banner or decorations (optional)
-   Frisbee, soft ball, or deck of cards for entertainment
-   Camera for photos
